sed -e 's/@BUCKET@/fyp-p82-20261005-018da1d6-803656589923/g' -e 's/@SOURCE_VERSION@/tSVUvzrVj5pVHZ0FEn2Fr6F1hRht_p.T/g' /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification/finalize-v1-template.sh >/opt/fyp-phase82-qualification/finalize-v1.sh
